name: Sadira Adala
source: Sadira, daughter of the eastern sultan, fled from an abusive father who did not allow her to enjoy life and her femininity. She needs no money and takes a job as a dancer at Lady Luck to enjoy the attention of men and satisfy her sexual needs.
